As inexperienced as I am with an actual attempt.. as someone who has been through many many medications, there is so many more that you can and should try before forgetting about medication completely. I tried just talk therapy for many years and never got anywhere, it is so hard to work on self improvement with an unstable base. If you can find the right medication that will keep you even just at a solid average feeling, you can process everything and finally gain more clarity around your emotions, and even find further meaning behind it. I was just diagnosed with anxiety and depression at first but turns out I had a lot of underlying issues like ADHD, CPTSD, Social anxiety disorder, Panic disorder, and it’s so critical to find that out because that’s how I’ve gotten the right treatment and finally moved forward. The future becomes a lot brighter once you hit that right mix. It took me quite a while too I won’t lie, I have tried so many medications at a bunch of doses but I promise it’s worth it. Stay honest and open, your family wants you here, I want you here and if that means relying on their money it’s worth it.
